content.text:
I've evened out the padding inside the chat input's text box, and the 29 chat input tests pass. I haven't looked at it in the running app, because my last screenshot attempt caught the wrong window. It still needs a visual check.

- **Text box:** the text now sits 8px from the box's top, left and right edges. The editor underneath (from gpui-kit, the UI library) pads its text 8px above and below but 10px at the sides, and that can't be changed from our code. So I widened the editor by 2px on each side to make up the difference. The top wasn't touched, so the first row still lines up with Send.
- **Preview:** "Preview Compiled Prompt" shows in the same dark box, and its text had no padding at all, sitting flush against the edges. It now has the same 8px inset on every side.

Both use one shared value in `src/chat_input.rs`, so they stay in step. The space around the box (from the tabs above, the window edges, and the gap to the buttons) was already an even 8px, so I left it alone.

With a single line typed, there's still more space below the text than above it. That's because the box is as tall as the three stacked buttons beside it, as in your mockup. The text starts at the top and fills that space as you type.
